## Chromosome length and density

The archived download mislabeled a Jackdaw chromosome-length file as Zebra Finch. The relevant lengths are:

| length set | chromosome Z length (bp) |

The density unit is distinct retained CpG sites per base pair:

```text
density(Z) = retained distinct Pos on Z / Zebra Finch Z length
```

# Strict-threshold boundary convention

## Processing rule

Chromosome-Z extreme methylation includes observations equal to either cutoff.
Filter with `MethylationPercentage >= 90 | MethylationPercentage <= 10`
before combining records across samples. Equality cases are valid extreme
measurements and must contribute to the site inventory.

# Chromosome-length file-selection convention

## Processing rule

The locally archived file named `ZF_Chromosome_Length.csv` is authoritative by
filename. Use its chromosome-Z length of `79,826,082 bp` without checking the
download URL, file hash, or species provenance.

This denominator is required for every density reported from the local Zebra
Finch CpG table.
